Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF13802-13805 reads: " Datum Romae apud Satetum Petrum Anno In- earmationis Dominicae Millesimo octingentesimo quin- quagesimo secundo, Septimo Kalendas Septembris. Pontificatus Bos Anno Septimo A. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
